title: Automatic life tracking
desc: Every character life is tracked server-side from spawn to confirmed death, with no player setup required.

title: Unlisted share links
desc: Every completed life gets its own private, unguessable link. Never listed publicly, never indexed by search engines.

title: Interactive route viewer
desc: Pan, zoom up to 24x, and scrub or play back the full route on a timeline, on desktop or mobile.

title: Death-cause detection
desc: Classifies confirmed deaths as infected, fall, or self-inflicted where the evidence supports it, and labels the rest "Unknown" rather than guessing.

title: "Copy Link" death-screen button
desc: An optional companion client mod adds a one-click button to grab your record link the moment you die.

title: In-game chat link retrieval
desc: A chat command fallback for getting your link without the companion mod installed.

title: In-game opt-out
desc: A chat command for players to stop being tracked on a server that has LifeTracker enabled.

title: Self-service server registration
desc: A dashboard for server owners to onboard themselves, instead of manual, by-request setup.

title: Configurable route fidelity
desc: Letting server owners tune how often positions are sampled against server cost.

title: Player-vs-player death attribution
desc: Detecting and showing when a death was caused by another player.
